nodes.label: ADR 0015: source mark-diacritics is additive transfer
nodes.rationale: source mark-diacritics exists to add helpful diacritics while preserving the source as closely as possible. Replacing each token with the macron-index display form silently swapped eth/thorn and added hyphens. Marks are copied onto matching source letters; no source character is removed, replaced, or re-cased. Unaligned index forms are reported instead of guessed, because a partial transfer could corrupt the source.

nodes.label: Additive diacritic transfer
nodes.rationale: The index form is aligned to the source token with case, ð≡þ, and hyphens ignored, and only combining marks are copied. Source ð/þ, casing, hyphenation, and marks already present are kept. En and em dashes count as hyphens for alignment and are never converted. If alignment fails, the token is unchanged.

nodes.label: Unaligned token
nodes.rationale: Unaligned means the index entry is inconsistent: its display form does not normalize to its own key. That is a different problem from .unknown (normalized key miss, including ae/æ or w/ƿ) and .anomalies (ambiguous). They stay separate so index repair is not mixed up with missing words. Hand-curated entries may still appear here and are left as curated.

nodes.label: GPalatalizer
nodes.rationale: A non-initial g is dotted only when a front vowel precedes it and a back vowel does not follow, so stīgan and wiga stay velar. Palatalizers compute on a lowercase copy and graft a combining dot so they never lowercase or re-case the source. The g exception lists use NFC, lowercase, and ð≡þ rather than normalize_old_english, because full normalization would strip macrons and conflate gēar with ġear.

nodes.label: g/frontal.txt palatalization exceptions
nodes.rationale: The file is the single hand-edited source of truth for frontal g exceptions, matching how CPalatalizer loads its lists. The hardcoded FRONTAL_G_EXCEPTIONS list was removed only after its 43 extra entries were appended, so existing velar protection was not dropped. ENDING_G_EXCEPTIONS stays in code because it has no file.

nodes.label: MacronApplicator
nodes.rationale: build_index_from_bt used to map every third-field variant to the first bold headword. apply now returns a 4-tuple including the unaligned index form. The applicator calls DiacriticTransfer.same_marks and takes an ambiguity policy, defaulting to leave.
